paragraphs.source_en: Suneemon considered, one after another, Katsuyori's intentions, Anayama Genba-no-kami's scheme, and his own predicament. He concluded that Katsuyori was not as cruel as rumor made him out to be. And though Genba-no-kami was a shrewd, calculating man who saw reality clearly, he had miscalculated one thing: he believed Suneemon would betray his lord to save his own life—and Suneemon was no such man.

units.source_en: Suneemon considered, one after another, Katsuyori's intentions, Anayama Genba-no-kami's scheme, and his own predicament.
units.source_zh: 胜赖之意、穴山玄蕃头的主意，还有自己的处境，强右卫门都前前后后想了一遍。

units.source_en: He concluded that Katsuyori was not as cruel as rumor made him out to be. And though Genba-no-kami was a shrewd, calculating man who saw reality clearly, he had miscalculated one thing: he believed Suneemon would betray his lord to save his own life—and Suneemon was no such man.
units.source_zh: 他认为胜赖并不像传说中那么残忍，而玄蕃头尽管是那种看透现实、精打细算之人，唯独算错了一件事——认为强右卫门为了活命，会背叛主子，而他绝不是那种人！

paragraphs.source_zh: 胜赖之意、穴山玄蕃头的主意，还有自己的处境，强右卫门都前前后后想了一遍。他认为胜赖并不像传说中那么残忍，而玄蕃头尽管是那种看透现实、精打细算之人，唯独算错了一件事——认为强右卫门为了活命，会背叛主子，而他绝不是那种人！

paragraphs.source_en: Led by Yarokuro, Suneemon was taken from the north side of the castle to the foot of the watchtower before the central commander's tent. The blazing sun scorched the earth. Here the opposing positions lay so close together that each side could make out the faces of the other's soldiers. Naturally, the sight of a man who looked like a common laborer being led in on a rope caught the attention of the soldiers inside the castle.

units.source_en: Led by Yarokuro, Suneemon was taken from the north side of the castle to the foot of the watchtower before the central commander's tent.
units.source_zh: 强右卫门被弥六郎牵着，从城北来到中军帐前的箭楼下。

units.source_zh: 炎炎烈日炙烤着大地。

units.source_zh: 在这里，双方的阵地很接近，都能看清对方士兵的长相。

units.source_en: Naturally, the sight of a man who looked like a common laborer being led in on a rope caught the attention of the soldiers inside the castle.

units.source_zh: 一个民夫模样的人被人用绳子牵了过来，当然吸引了城里士兵的注意。

paragraphs.source_zh: 强右卫门被弥六郎牵着，从城北来到中军帐前的箭楼下。炎炎烈日炙烤着大地。在这里，双方的阵地很接近，都能看清对方士兵的长相。一个民夫模样的人被人用绳子牵了过来，当然吸引了城里士兵的注意。

paragraphs.source_en: “Ah, it's Suneemon!”

units.source_en: “Ah, it's Suneemon!”
units.source_zh: “啊，是强右卫门！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “啊，是强右卫门！”

paragraphs.source_en: “Lord Torii has been captured!”

units.source_en: “Lord Torii has been captured!”
units.source_zh: “是鸟居大人被抓了！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “是鸟居大人被抓了！”

paragraphs.source_en: In an instant, a commotion swept through the castle. From windows, beneath the shade of trees, and over stone walls, one hardened face after another peered out.

units.source_en: In an instant, a commotion swept through the castle.
units.source_zh: 转瞬间，城内起了一阵骚动。

units.source_en: From windows, beneath the shade of trees, and over stone walls, one hardened face after another peered out.
units.source_zh: 窗户里，树荫下，石墙上，探出一张张精悍的脸来。

paragraphs.source_zh: 转瞬间，城内起了一阵骚动。窗户里，树荫下，石墙上，探出一张张精悍的脸来。

paragraphs.source_en: That morning, everyone had seen the signal fires on Mount Ganpō, and every man among them had rejoiced. “We're saved now. The reinforcements are coming.”

units.source_en: That morning, everyone had seen the signal fires on Mount Ganpō, and every man among them had rejoiced.
units.source_zh: 今天早晨，大家都看见了雁峰山上的烟火，个个都很高兴。

units.source_en: “We're saved now. The reinforcements are coming.”
units.source_zh: “这下好了，援军来了。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 今天早晨，大家都看见了雁峰山上的烟火，个个都很高兴。“这下好了，援军来了。”

paragraphs.source_en: Just as their spirits were soaring, the sight of their own messenger in captivity plunged them into grief.

units.source_en: Just as their spirits were soaring, the sight of their own messenger in captivity plunged them into grief.
units.source_zh: 正当大家大受鼓舞的时候，看到自己的使者被捕，都无比悲痛。

paragraphs.source_zh: 正当大家大受鼓舞的时候，看到自己的使者被捕，都无比悲痛。

paragraphs.source_en: Anayama Genba-no-kami had not accompanied them. He believed Suneemon to be an honest man and felt certain that he would say exactly what they had agreed beforehand.

units.source_en: Anayama Genba-no-kami had not accompanied them. He believed Suneemon to be an honest man and felt certain that he would say exactly what they had agreed beforehand.
units.source_zh: 穴山玄蕃头没有跟过来，他觉得强右卫门这个人老实，一定会按照事先约好的去说。

paragraphs.source_zh: 穴山玄蕃头没有跟过来，他觉得强右卫门这个人老实，一定会按照事先约好的去说。

paragraphs.source_en: “Good. This is far enough.” Yarokuro came over to untie Suneemon, muttering softly to him as he worked.

units.source_en: “Good. This is far enough.”
units.source_zh: “好，到这儿就行了。”

units.source_en: Yarokuro came over to untie Suneemon, muttering softly to him as he worked.
units.source_zh: 弥六郎过来给强右卫门解绳子，一边小声地对他嘟囔。

paragraphs.source_en: A thunderous cheer suddenly erupted from within the castle. At that moment, two Takeda guards leaped onto the rocks, seized Torii Suneemon, and dragged him down, then beat him savagely without stopping to ask what had happened. Even so, Suneemon felt exhilarated and wanted to shout aloud several times over.

units.source_en: A thunderous cheer suddenly erupted from within the castle.
units.source_zh: 城内哗地欢声雷动。

units.source_en: At that moment, two Takeda guards leaped onto the rocks, seized Torii Suneemon, and dragged him down, then beat him savagely without stopping to ask what had happened.
units.source_zh: 就在这时，武田家的两名侍卫跳上岩石，一把把鸟居强右卫门拉了下来，然后不分青红皂白，一顿痛打。

units.source_en: Even so, Suneemon felt exhilarated and wanted to shout aloud several times over.
units.source_zh: 尽管如此，强右卫门还是觉得爽快，想大喊几声。

paragraphs.source_zh: 城内哗地欢声雷动。就在这时，武田家的两名侍卫跳上岩石，一把把鸟居强右卫门拉了下来，然后不分青红皂白，一顿痛打。尽管如此，强右卫门还是觉得爽快，想大喊几声。

paragraphs.source_en: “Damn him! The scoundrel planned this from the start.”

units.source_en: “Damn him! The scoundrel planned this from the start.”
units.source_zh: “妈的，这厮早就有预谋。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “妈的，这厮早就有预谋。”

paragraphs.source_en: “How dare he try such a trick!”

units.source_en: “How dare he try such a trick!”
units.source_zh: “居然敢玩花样！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “居然敢玩花样！”

paragraphs.source_en: The Takeda guards kicked and cursed him. Battered back and forth like a roly-poly doll, Suneemon never uttered a sound.

units.source_en: The Takeda guards kicked and cursed him. Battered back and forth like a roly-poly doll, Suneemon never uttered a sound.
units.source_zh: 武田的侍卫们连踢带骂，强右卫门被撞过来踢过去，活像一个不倒翁，却一声不吭。

paragraphs.source_zh: 武田的侍卫们连踢带骂，强右卫门被撞过来踢过去，活像一个不倒翁，却一声不吭。

paragraphs.source_en: “I am deeply sorry.”

units.source_en: “I am deeply sorry.”
units.source_zh: “十分抱歉。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “十分抱歉。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Everything is ruined. You raised my hopes for nothing.”

units.source_en: “Everything is ruined. You raised my hopes for nothing.”
units.source_zh: “什么都泡汤了，你让我空欢喜一场。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “什么都泡汤了，你让我空欢喜一场。”

paragraphs.source_en: “I am truly sorry, but I knew that was not something a warrior should do. In such circumstances, even your own lord would never do anything that harmed an ally. In any event, I have wronged you, so please forgive me. You may dispose of me however you please.”

paragraphs.source_zh: “实在抱歉，但我知道那不是武士应该做的。在这种场合，就是你家主公，也不会做出不利于盟友的事。反正我做了对不起您的事，请原谅，只要您高兴，怎么处置都可以。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Hmph!”

units.source_en: “Hmph!”

paragraphs.source_en: Another lash fell, but even that could not wipe the smile from Suneemon's face.

units.source_en: Another lash fell, but even that could not wipe the smile from Suneemon's face.

ja.t: すことはできなかった。

units.source_zh: 又是一鞭，但始终抽不掉强右卫门的微笑。

paragraphs.source_zh: 又是一鞭，但始终抽不掉强右卫门的微笑。

paragraphs.source_en: A great many men hoisted the cross upright. At the sight, the men inside the castle stood frozen in shock. By then, the whole world visible to Suneemon consisted of nothing but blue sky and white clouds.

units.source_en: A great many men hoisted the cross upright.
units.source_zh: 十字架被好多人抬了起来。

units.source_en: At the sight, the men inside the castle stood frozen in shock.
units.source_zh: 看到这种情形，城内的人呆若木鸡。

units.source_en: By then, the whole world visible to Suneemon consisted of nothing but blue sky and white clouds.
units.source_zh: 这时，强右卫门眼里所能看到的世界，就只有蓝天白云了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 十字架被好多人抬了起来。看到这种情形，城内的人呆若木鸡。这时，强右卫门眼里所能看到的世界，就只有蓝天白云了。

paragraphs.source_en: “Hey, do you think our lord will approve of torture like this?”

units.source_en: “Hey, do you think our lord will approve of torture like this?”
units.source_zh: “喂，你们说，这样的酷刑，主公会答应吗？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “喂，你们说，这样的酷刑，主公会答应吗？”

paragraphs.source_en: “Who cares whether he approves? We just have to show those people in the castle!”

units.source_en: “Who cares whether he approves? We just have to show those people in the castle!”
units.source_zh: “管他答应不答应，就是要给城里的那些人看看！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “管他答应不答应，就是要给城里的那些人看看！”

paragraphs.source_en: The voices reached Suneemon's ears, but to him they no longer sounded like voices from his world.

units.source_en: The voices reached Suneemon's ears, but to him they no longer sounded like voices from his world.
units.source_zh: 这声音虽然传到强右卫门的耳朵里，但是，听来已不是他这个世界的声音了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 这声音虽然传到强右卫门的耳朵里，但是，听来已不是他这个世界的声音了。

paragraphs.source_en: Suneemon wanted to laugh, but he could no longer make a sound. The warrior took down his quiver and sketched Suneemon in his final moments. This scene unfolded before the camp of Yamagata Saburōbei at Ariakehara, while the setting sun stained the horizon blood-red.

units.source_en: Suneemon wanted to laugh, but he could no longer make a sound.

paragraphs.source_zh: 强右卫门想笑，可是他已经发不出声音了。那武士取下箭筒，把强右卫门的最后一刻画了下来。这一幕发生在有海原山县三郎兵卫的阵营前面，夕阳映得天边一片血红。
